visual_strategy.structured_blocks: All three numbered main figures, both main tables, all five supplementary figures, and all four supplementary tables are represented in structured text in the SEA.
visual_strategy.embedded_crops_or_screenshots: None embedded. Figure S4 was visually inspected from the rendered source page and its printed point estimates were transcribed into the structured block.
omitted_with_reason: Investigator rosters were inspected but not condensed person-by-person because they do not alter efficacy or safety interpretation.
Repeated historical protocol/TSAP pages were used for version reconciliation rather than reproduced in full.

coverage_decision: Full main article plus materially relevant appendix and final protocol/TSAP content included. Bibliography routed to a separate reference task queue.
